_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: I found a home in you; a place where I am fully understood. I do not feel alone in the world when I am behind your doors. My heart feels safe with your white picket fence wrapped around it.
